facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary 6MWD endpoint (p=0.0320 vs 0.025) · Phase 3 PROSERA · seralutinib in pulmonary arterial hypertension · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The estimated Hodges‑Lehmann treatment effect was +13.3 meters, with a p‑value of 0.0320, which did not meet the prespecified threshold on the primary endpoint (α = 0.025)
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The estimated Hodges‑Lehmann treatment effect was +13.3 meters, with a p‑value of 0.0320, which did not meet the prespecified threshold on the primary endpoint (α = 0.025)
evidence.safety: Overall, seralutinib was generally well tolerated in the PROSERA Study.
evidence.program_discontinued: Gossamer expects to meet with the U.S. FDA to discuss the path forward for seralutinib in pulmonary arterial hypertension.
